# Khadybousso Hair Braiding

> African hair braiding studio based in Pflugerville, Texas. Knotless and box braids, cornrows and feed-ins, Senegalese and kinky twists, crochet, locs and kids' styles in Pflugerville. Neat, professional work at fair prices, with old braids taken down, washed and redone in one stop.

- Phone: (512) 696-4235
- Based in: Pflugerville, TX
- Nearby areas: Pflugerville, Round Rock, Austin, Hutto, Manor
- Google rating: 4.7 from 50 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/khadybousso-hair-braiding/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/braiding-salons/texas/khadybousso-hair-braiding/book.html

## Services
- Knotless braids: Light, natural-looking knotless braids with clean square parts, in black or color blends. Bra length $180, waist length $200.
- Box braids: Classic box braids with neat, even parting, including patterned parts. Bra length $160, waist $180, past waist $200.
- Cornrows & feed-ins: Straight-back and designed cornrows, feed-in braids and braided ponytails for women, men and kids. From $50.
- Senegalese & kinky twists: Rope-smooth Senegalese twists and fuller kinky twists, plus two-strand twists on natural hair. From $80.
- Kids' braids & beads: Gentle cornrows and ponytails for little ones, finished with beads or pearl clips. Kids' cornrows $80.
- Crochet, sew-ins & locs: Crochet styles, sew-ins, French curl, butterfly locs, loc extensions, retwists and sister locs.

## About
Khadybousso Hair Braiding is Khady Bousso's studio in Suite A at 15630 Vision Dr, Pflugerville. In her words: “I provide all services from box braid, Senegalese twist, sister locs and many other services. I also sell hair. My goal is to make my clients glow from inside out.” Inside, the stations are lit by gold-framed vanity mirrors, the chairs are black leather, and one wall is Texas limestone, with braiding hair stocked on the rack by the door. Reviewers call the braiders experts, the work neat and clean, and the prices fair. Parents bring their daughters back again and again, and busy professionals love that old braids can come out, the scalp gets washed and new braids go in, all in one stop.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: What are your hours?
  A: Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM. For Sunday and holiday hours, call (512) 696-4235 or check open times on the booking page.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Box braids start at $160 (bra length), knotless braids at $180, Senegalese twists at $180 and cornrows at $50. Longer lengths cost more; the full price list is on the Services page.
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online through the GlossGenius booking page, send a request on this site, or call (512) 696-4235. A photo of the style you want helps.
- Q: Can you take out my old braids first?
  A: Yes. For an added charge we take down your old braids, shampoo your scalp and re-braid you in the same visit. Mention it when you book.
- Q: What is your cancellation policy?
  A: Cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Late cancellations are charged 50% of the service, no-shows 100%, and arriving more than 15 minutes late cancels the appointment. Card payments add a 2.6% processing fee.
- Q: Do you sell braiding hair?
  A: Yes, Khady sells hair at the studio. Ask when you book if you would like hair included.
